purpose: Test whether a learned model of the system's own next-state dynamics improves held-out control against a matched reactive controller under identical disturbances.

policies.self_model: fit linear next-state model e_next = beta0 + beta1*e + beta2*a from training trajectories; choose action maximizing predicted reward
policies.reactive: choose action from current e only using fixed threshold controller: +1 if e<4.5, -1 if e>5.5, else 0
policies.oracle: choose action using true transition model and the current held-out disturbance; positive control only

metrics.prediction_rmse: RMSE of self-model one-step prediction on held-out self-policy transitions

interpretation_rule: PASS establishes only the registered operational property that a learned model of the system's own state dynamics improves held-out control. It does not establish consciousness, subjective self-awareness, general self-knowledge, intelligence, or universality.
